title: No lanterns
logline: The Grunion Run with no lanterns at all. The fish come by moonlight. The pup, eleven, walks the surf slowly. A man from behind on the sand. The page in silver and black.

panels.composition: A night beach with no lanterns, the surf line silver with fish under a moon, an old three-legged dog walking it slowly, a man seen from behind sitting on the dark sand. Silver and black only.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a moonlit night beach with no lanterns and a surf line silver with small fish, an old three-legged dog walking it slowly and a man seen from behind sitting on the dark sand, silver and black only, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: No lanterns. The fish by moonlight.
